facts.description: An interactive five-chapter night walk through a Kyoto mountain temple, rendered live in Three.js.

research.name: Kage
research.note: Single-file Three.js scroll piece that moves a camera through a procedural night temple under a red moon.
research.license: No license granted (no LICENSE file; README states no license is granted for reuse or redistribution of the code or artwork)

effects: scroll-driven camera walk through a procedurally built Three.js temple, torii and stone stairs
vermilion moon with rain, drifting maple leaves and film grain over the live scene
generated image plates and foreground cutouts (pine, maple branches, lanterns) layered as HTML over the WebGL canvas for collage depth
oversized KAGE wordmark set inside the 3D scene behind the torii
